article.title: I have not eaten rice since I left Gaza. The taste is a painful reminder of the genocide.
article.author: Roaa Shamallakh
article.content: In Gaza, hunger and siege changed the meanings of bread, rice, khobeiza, and oud. Three years after reaching Cairo, ordinary foods and fragrances still return me to the war.
